answers.assumption_check: Measured: A python script a proof runs as a SUBPROCESS is missing from the reach log when it runs to its last line, .py and extensionless alike, so editing it cannot stale the seal. CPython 3.14.4 pops __main__.__file__ once the script completes, and cairn/devices/tester/reach/sitecustomize.py reads every module __file__ at atexit, after the pop. A script that raises SystemExit keeps __file__ and IS logged. Repro, 2026-11-20 on akiendelllinux: /var/tmp/noext_probe = 'import sys,atexit; atexit.register(lambda: print("atexit", getattr(sys.modules["__main__"],"__file__",None)))' then a plain last line prints 'atexit None' (also as noext_probe.py); /var/tmp/noext_probe2 ending 'raise SystemExit(0)' prints 'atexit /var/tmp/noext_probe2'. Live: CAIRN_TESTER_REACH_LOG=<f> PYTHONPATH=cairn/devices/tester/reach python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/fixtures/extensionless_leaf (then ending normally) logged only the editable finder and sitecustomize.py. Found building b7d5df9919fe's clause 4; all 28 bin/cmd scripts exit via SystemExit, so the gates are covered and the blind set is any other subprocess-run script that ends normally. Assumed: sys.argv[0] is the script path the interpreter ran for a `python <script>` child (it is, per the interpreter docs, and the repro will confirm in the proof).

Capturing at import is not available — sitecustomize runs before __main__ is set.
